Definition: to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything
BiblicalUsage: Gada means to cut off, to fell, to destroy — and it is used for arms, altars, and idols alike. The LORD says He will cut off the arm of Eli's house in 1 Samuel 2:31, and He commands Israel to hew down the graven images of the nations in Deuteronomy 12:3. The horns of the altar at Bethel shall be cut off in Amos 3:14, and the people cut down the groves and threw down the high places in 2 Chronicles 31:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe cutting off is God's surgery on what corrupts His people. Altars, groves, and proud arms must all fall, and I hold that the God who cuts away idols is the same God who saves the remnant.
